avis.texte: This is like a film sitting on the skin and never sinks in. It actually rolled right off while applying makeup.
Feels refreshing and helps to diminish dark circles and fine lines.
This eye serum is my new BFF! Some mornings I wake up with puffiness and this serum feels so nice, sort of cooling and the applicator tip is the perfect touch.
Very helpful after nights I don't get much sleep. Great mom tool!
I really like this product. I love the way it feels on my eyes. It wakes me up in the morning

I was really excited for this, but unfortunately it kind of stings under my eyes. I keep it in the fridge, so the metal tip feels nice and cold as I rub it on; great feature! But overall, not a great product for me.

I love this eye serum because it moisturizes my under eyes and since working some night shifts it's been great to depuff my under eyes in the morning. I also really like the gold applicator it feels so nice and cool when applying!
Perfect applicator that is cooling to the touch. My eyes feel awake and I've noticed less fine lines.

avis.titre: Mold Growth and Less Effective than Affordable Eye Serums
avis.texte: This product isn't as effective as other more affordable eye serums on the market. I noticed that if you don't use it after a day or two it starts to get brown and gunk up. I thought it was just oxidating. I just looked at the product after not using it for a couple weeks and I'm pretty sure the product is growing mold. Maybe it's the ingredients, but this is digusting.

avis.titre: Be careful if you have sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I use many eye creams yet am careful about what I choose. I saw great reviews for Dime so I gave it a try over 1 year ago, and this cream gave me such a bad reaction under my eyes that I STILL have red, burning patches of skin under my eyes that flares up!

Can't believe I didn't return this after trying it the first 2-xs after purchase. Another waste on an eye cream only this is close to / if not directly in the bottom ranking pile. So disappointed.... I kept it to, keep trying it out , like an idiot thinking some miracle was gonna hapoen as the product was not cheap and also had okay star reviews when I purchased like anything maybe results would show up after a few more chances? Nope... All it did was nothing. Well, it did do something it stung/burned my under eyes! Would not recommend. Not even on sale! What a let down... :(

I loved the way this product felt on my skin. I used it for about 2 months and unfortunately it molded on the applicator. I wish they could find some type of quality control with their products. The tbt line and fragrances are the only things good with dime.
I apply this eye cream and wait a little bit for it to absorb then I do my makeup, and it peels! I tried every concealer I own and it still peels. Will not purchase again
I would really like this if it didnt pill and clump under makeup
I didn't really expect to see much difference with this eye serum, so I tried it under just one eye to see the difference and it was pretty obvious. Great product.
Feels nice on. Love that it comes in a tube for easy application
I've been using this product for about a month. Nothing to report, nothing special.
Love the metal tip! It gives a soothing spa feel to morning routine. Very hydrating under my eyes too.
I had used this for a couple of weeks when something black was in it. It turned out it was a worm. I was totally disgusted thst I had used this under my eyes
Feels so good when you put it on. The metal is so cooling and the formula with it is so smoothing.

I have been using Dime products for almost 3 years and it's truly made a difference in my skin complexion. The Hyper Glow, Luminosity Eye Serum and Dewey Day Cream have been great products for my skin. My skin is smoother and brighter. I also use the Gently Jelly Cleanser and Super Skin Toner for my daily daytime cleansing regime. Thanks Baylee for this great clean products you've created. I love them!
This is the best eye serum I have used. It is cool and refreshing feeling, and silk like moisturizing. I will stick with this product to help diminish fine lines.
Great serum. . helps in the morning with puffiness!! Makes my eyes feel refreshed!

avis.titre: Just a little but still nothing
avis.texte: I have been using this product for over 6 weeks. I did not see much improvement other than just a little bit on winkle lines and puffiness but nothing significant or noticeable. Over six weeks of use should have given me enough time to decide whether to repurchase or not. Well, i decided NOT to buy again so as not to suffer any further from stinging and burning sensation. This is not the one for me.

This is one of the best eye serums I have tried! It goes on smooth, not sticky and really helps firm the sensitive area around my eyes making them look less puffy & much brighter. I've tried many eye creams and serums and this is by far a favorite.
I love this eye cream! The cold applicator feels so good in the morning and I definitely see a difference after applying it.
This feels like a drink a water for you under eyes. Keeps them hydrated and feeling fresh
The eye serum is wonderful, it really quenches the dryness around my eyes!
Love the way it makes my eyes. The cooling roller feels great
This formula is awful. Burns & clumps up. Makes my under eyes ao dry. Please find something else.

I LOVE this product. As I have gotten older & stress has been more of a constant, sleep has been elusive. My favorite feature of my face - my eyes- have suffered. I love this product, and the way it makes my eyes glow and brighten. I think it helps them look plumped and firm, not baggy, sunk and dark.
This eye cream goes on smoothly and makes the area around my eyes feel smoother and tighter. It does well under my makeup.
I love the new design of this product with the new roller ball. It goes on much easier. The product does seem to flake off though and leaves residue on your face.
I've only been using for 30 days but I can see small changes in my crows feet combined with the tbt under eye cream
Fresh feeling formula that leaves my eyes brighter and refreshed!

avis.titre: Don't put this on your face
avis.texte: I bought this a few weeks ago and tried it out. It felt very warm and burned the first time i tried it. I waited a few days and tried it again, no burning but still very warm. I used it a few more times then put it in a drawer and forgot about it. I went to pull it out again and the serum had eaten away at the metal applicator. If it eats and corodes metal i dont think you should be putting it BY YOUR EYES !!
The cooling metal tip feels nice, but is immediately replaced my burning/stinging around my eyes.

I use a majority of Dime products and i love them all. This feels so good on the eyes in the morning after waking and up. It cools and hydrates. I don't have a ton of puffiness, but my eyes seem brigter, hydrated, and less puffy 5-10 min after appyling. I will continue to purchase!!! LOVE DIME!!!
This eye serum glides on with ease and absorbs beautifully. I only buy this when its on sale.

avis.titre: This cannot be used under make up
avis.texte: This cannot be applied before or under makeup because it pills up Terrribly, into little and not so little pieces. Because of that I haven't been using it consistently, so I'm not sure how effective it really is.
I really wish I could wear this. This product does make my dark circles brighter, but it burns so bad!
A lovely experience to apply, long lasting, and not too heavy
Always loved the product. Im not a fan of dipping my fingers in and Im happy to not have the heavy glass dish. I love the gold applicator. Makes a smooth sweep of refresh for my eyes
Been using this daily for about a month with no noticeable benefits. I'm not sure there is any product that will reduce puffiness.

I really like this eye cream! I've been loyal to a different one for years, but after trying this, I don't even want to go back to my old tube. I love the subtle tightening feel, and the slight glossy finish is perfect for makeup-free days. So far, it definitely seems to be doing its job!
The eye serum helps brighten and cover the circles that have formed under my eyes. I was hoping it would help them go away. It hasn't done that but it definitely helps and I will buy it again!

avis.titre: So far so good! Love the
avis.texte: So far so good! Love the packaging and the cool, metal tip on the applicator. Feels very nice when applying. Havent been using it long enough to see results.

avis.titre: Cooling & hydrating. Not great at de-puffing.
avis.texte: Bought this on sale. For that reason I'll keep using it -- the ingredients are wonderfully nourishing and the cold application feels wonderful in the morning because of the metal tip. If it were full price I probably would've returned it though. I just don't feel it accomplishes what it claims as far as dark circles and de-puffing, at least in my case. The photos show before, immediately after, and 30 mins after. I didn't see any significant reduction in puffiness. Although there's no magic product that will keep you from looking tired if you're tired, this didn't give me as much of a boost I was looking for to justify the price. The skin did feel soft, luminous, and super moisturized -- good product in that regard.

avis.titre: Been using this for years, happy Ulta has it now!
avis.texte: I love this under eye cream. It feels lightweight and refreshing. Some under eye creams feel heavy and sticky but not this one. It is the perfect addition to my skin care routine. I really love DIME products. Their ingredients are super clean.
Wish there was a little more color but it feels good. Not sticky and smells good
I can tell a difference in eye bags and fine lines after 1.5 months of use!
I love all of dime, but the eye serum is a new staple!! The consistency is beautiful, lightweight but super hydrating and last incredibly u see SPF and makeup.

I've tried so many things to brighten my eyes but this is the most effective I've ever used. I feel like I no longer look tired - I use it every day!

Eye cream is a must in your 30's and beyond! Feels great and make my eyes look awake and bright!

avis.titre: If I could, I would give
